summary: Frontend-only regression for Cosmos Cannabis Cure iteration: age gate, homepage 'hovered' crash fix, 4-product collection + View All, anatomy hover, /legal page, checkout prescription upload + declaration gate, COD order confirmation, admin Rx column + View link + blob popup, and new green-leaf logo. issues: Order rows / stat values render at very low contrast in the screenshot (faded gray). Verify text contrast (customer name, order id, phone) against dark background — may just be low opacity classes but worth reviewing accessibility (WCAG AA).

critical_code_review_comments: Home.js: `products.slice(0,4)` renders 4 cards correctly, and hovered state is now declared at line 36 — homepage no longer crashes. Confirmed no runtime 'hovered is not defined' errors in console/pageerror during hover of Cola/Trichome/Calyx.

Checkout.js: place-order-btn `disabled` is correctly gated on `!declared`; prescription upload uses api.post /prescriptions/upload and shows filename + toast. COD path (`payment_method: 'cod'`) succeeds and finishes with order-confirmation.
AdminDashboard.js: view-rx-<orderId> renders only when order has prescription_file_id; clicking opens a blob:// URL in a new tab (verified). Rx column header present.
Legal.js: All 5 numbered sections, 4 compliance badges, and legal-disclaimer render. Footer legal link present and navigates to /legal.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test COD orders during testing (customer 'Test User', COD, one with uploaded prescription png). No cleanup required per request.
